faq.q: What are AI lifestyle product photos?
faq.a: They place your product inside a believable real-life scene, such as a kitchen counter or cafe table, starting from one plain product photo.
Upload one clear product photo, choose a setting and describe the scene in one sentence. The generated image keeps your item in that context.

faq.q: Are AI lifestyle product photos suitable for ecommerce?
faq.a: Yes. Use the square image on product pages, Shopify listings and social posts alongside a plain photo that shows the exact item.

faq.q: Can I choose the setting for my product?
faq.a: Yes. Name a room, surface, light and one or two props, or choose a ready-made scene. One clear setting usually works well.

faq.q: Can I customize the generated scene?
faq.a: Yes. Ask for fewer props, a different surface or another room, then generate a new version from that product photo.

faq.q: Does it replace my plain product image?
faq.a: No. Keep a plain view so shoppers can inspect the item and its size. The staged scene shows where it fits into daily life.

faq.q: Can the photo run in social ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark and are licensed for commercial use. Add any price or offer in your ad editor.

faq.q: How is product staging different from a photoshoot?
faq.a: A shoot needs props, a space and often a crew. Here the scene comes from one existing photo in minutes, at far less cost.
